title: Token Engineering on Cardano: Step-by-step tutorials to design economic mechanisms

ms.promise:
In this first module we will provide 2 videos. The first video will introduce Yohann and give an overview of the course curriculum. The second video will be a tutorial: Introduction to Token engineering, covering the topics below and relating it to Cardano & the UTXO model. 
- Seeing blockchains through an institutional perspective help us understand digital crypto-economic systems.
- Why it is important to understand human behaviour in a digital world of complex interactions.
- The what of Token Engineering, why it matters and how it benefits Cardano.
Any documentation - diagrams, exercises, and collaborative tools used in the tutorials will be posted to GitHub. Resources we have referred to will be shared in notes. All text files will be translated to Japanese, including video subtitles.
We cannot predict the exact length of the videos but they may range anywhere from 5-15 minutes. The introduction video will be shorter (2-5 mins).
This initial module will incur a higher cost due to setting up production workflows for future modules.
ms.criteria:
Both Overview and Introduction to Token Engineering videos published to our website - tokenflows.xyz and Youtube channel - @tokenflows; complete with Japanese subtitles (available) and accessible to the public.
Any documentation used in the tutorials posted to our GitHub (tokenflows), complete with Japanese translations as separate files.
